summary: Validated public FastAPI CRUD/dashboard integration and Expo web preview at 390x844. Backend regression passed; mobile role picker and citizen composer flow passed.
action_items: Implement distinct content/state for Municipal Priority queue, Teams, and Overview tabs; currently all staff tabs render StaffHome unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Staff tab state is updated but never used to conditionally render different workspace sections.
PATCH accepts arbitrary status strings without validation; consider constraining status values with an enum if business rules require it.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed report through the public API for CRUD verification; it remains in the database because no DELETE endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API URL from frontend/.env was used. Browser flow verified all three role cards, municipal dashboard load, profile role switching, citizen composer, category selection, description entry, camera control visibility, and submit control visibility. Browser location permission was unavailable, so UI displayed fallback coordinates/location unavailable as designed.
rca_of_issue: Staff navigation calls setTab(key), but Index always renders StaffHome for non-citizen roles and StaffHome has no tab prop. Therefore Overview, Priority queue, and Teams buttons do not change rendered content.
